snippet.title: Leafborn Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247440/Leafborn

You are a living storm of a thousand leaves. Reshape into lethal weapons, burst through enemies, and soar across floating sky islands. Every run unlocks new forms and endless paths in this fluid 3D roguelite action game 

X: https://x.com/hasan_tarhann
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/leafborngame/
Website: https://leafborngame.net/
